teaser: A ledger gets checked twice before anyone else sees the total. Life path 8 is the number of material mastery, and ENTJ is the type built to run the operation that makes the mastery real. Put the two together and you get someone who does not just want to win, but wants the win counted, audited, repeatable. The question this crossing raises is not whether you can build something. It is whether the building includes the people standing inside it.
excerpt: The smell of coffee going cold on a desk, because the conversation about the mortgage ran over the conversation about the wedding date.
